name: DetailList
summary: Label/value pairs describing one thing (a summary, a receipt, a review step).

total.description: The total row of a receipt, shown emphasised after a divider

variant.description: 'receipt' for money: values right-aligned in tabular figures, with an optional total row

whenToUse: Showing the attributes of one entity
Fees, prices and totals before someone commits (variant 'receipt')
whenNotToUse: Many entities with the same attributes: use Table

requirements: Label and value are programmatically associated

agent: Read each label with its value.
rendering: Keeps the item order stable across generations (keys are remembered)
receipt: values right-aligned in tabular figures, the total row emphasised; people read amounts from the right

mappings.ios: LabeledContent rows in a Form/List section
